risk.title: What you're probably wondering
risk.subtitle: We'd rather answer these now than have you leave unsure.

items.question: What if my data isn't clean enough?
items.answer: Vuen works with messy CSVs, half-filled spreadsheets, and real-world databases. You don't need to prep your data first — just upload and ask.

items.question: Will this replace my existing BI tools?
items.answer: No. Vuen sits alongside your current stack. It's for the 90% of your company that never logs into Tableau or Power BI. Your analysts keep their tools — everyone else gets answers.

items.question: How hard is it to get started?
items.answer: Upload a file or connect a database. Ask a question in plain English. That's it. No training, no SQL, no big setup. Most teams are asking questions within 5 minutes.

items.question: What happens to my data?
items.answer: Your data never leaves your servers. SOC 2 Type II certified. GDPR compliant. Enterprise plans can run on your own machines. We don't train on your data — ever.

items.question: What if it gives wrong answers?
items.answer: Every chart shows the source file and the question it used. You can check any answer right away. Vuen shows its work so you never have to blindly trust a number.

items.question: What if I outgrow the free plan?
items.answer: The free plan gives you 40 questions per month to see if it works for you. Upgrade when you're ready — or don't. No lock-in, no contracts, cancel anytime.

risk.bottomText: Still unsure? Try it free — no credit card, no commitment.
